scope: Sanitized, portable performance validation for the GitHub release. Raw local traces are intentionally excluded.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, 6 GB

method.map: NO.B212F6 / 天枢云阙A大进攻预瞄
method.renderLoad: 1920x1080 browser viewport override; 100% scale, shadows, full Champions 2023 Vandal model, native animation and muzzle effects
method.workload: Three repetitions per candidate. Same deterministic ten-simulation-second native-engine script: idle, fire, reload, melee, inspect, fire. Scores and replays discarded.
method.metrics: RAF intervals and CPU submissions, not presented-frame counts or manual gameplay. 1% Low is 1000 divided by the mean of the slowest ceil(intervalCount*0.01) raw intervals; it is not 1000/p99.
method.gpu: Asynchronous EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 elapsed segment. May include CPU submission gaps; does not isolate shader time or include browser compositor work.
method.focus: OS samples were aligned to each measurement window. The busiest renderer was checked for Normal priority and EcoQoS. DOM focus alone was not accepted as proof.
method.limits: Short repeated tests are not a guarantee for every map, weapon, thermal state or sustained manual gameplay. No candidate was selected solely on a single best run.

productionChanges: hide covered hall DOM while training is active
Edge launch flags prevent renderer/occluded-window/background-timer throttling
bounded native tracer/impact presentation-object pools with four shared atlas frames

resourceAccounting.kind: Actual native factory functions with mocked presentation resources; does not measure GPU speed

earlierHallIsolation.kind: Independent same-build visibility A/B, not the repeated full-HD baseline

measurements.name: baseline
measurements.decision: reference: existing hall, scheduling and skeleton fixes

measurements.name: effects
measurements.decision: not enabled together: no consistent FPS/1% Low benefit

measurements.name: spatial
measurements.decision: rejected: fewer triangles but too many draw calls

measurements.name: selective
measurements.decision: rejected: no consistent benefit and slow frames

measurements.name: final
measurements.decision: production: existing fixes plus bounded impact/tracer reuse

slowFrameFinding.interpretation: The largest event was in the world renderer. A full browser/driver trace would be needed to distinguish CPU work, driver submission stalls and scheduling; no unsupported root-cause attribution is made.
